description:
OWNER of docs/eval-in-cl-plan.md (s533, 2026-11-04; the USER asked for string eval in CL alone, no Perl subprocess, and whether more XS than Clone is needed).

MEASURED (s533 review session): the compiler closure = 177 files (23 Pl/, 90 PPI, 62 others); 18 XS modules -- all shimmed / pure-Perl halves / never loaded EXCEPT Params::Util (needs a ~10-line must-win shim loading Params::Util::PP; PERL_PARAMS_UTIL_PP=1 works today).  Transpile census 122 files / 79,562 lines: 119 clean, drops #4481 (PCL) + #4482 (PPI), Pl/PPIBugs.pm refused (85,620-char form > 64,000).  PPI under PCL with #4481 worked around: identical to perl on Calc.pm (19,983 tokens, 59 subs), parse 0.66 s vs 0.19 s, find 0.17 vs 0.02 s; warm process 7.5 s of which ~6 s fasl loading.  Today: first eval ~0.35 s (perl loads compiler + PPI), ~16 ms per distinct text.

PHASES: P0 hash-order determinism (#3961) -> P1 PPI under PCL (PPI's own 57,396-assertion suite as conformance; #4481 #4482 Params::Util shim) -> P2 the compiler under PCL (P2a Moo out, optional), bar = byte-identical emission vs the perl-hosted compiler over the four populations -> P3 the compiler in the saved core -> P4 eval in the image (PCL_TRANSPILER=image|perl) -> P5 modules + default flip + a no-perl container leg -> P6 stage-2 fixed point in CI.

OPEN USER QUESTIONS: Moo out of the compiler?  ~3x slower uncached evals acceptable, or perl default where perl exists?  When (P0+P1 now, P2.. after C2)?

Scratch: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-pcl/f08f1d5c-4e5d-421d-9a67-9f0a02cb932c/scratchpad/selfhost (census.tsv, classes.txt, ppi-*.out, ppi-bench.pl).
